title: The road home
summary: Hale the smith, sheltering in the woodland since the storm, goes ahead of you to what is left of Crossroads.

walks_off.speaker: hale
walks_off.why: as her talk closes she sets off toward the door to Crossroads and fades out after about 60 texels, round the player if he is in her way (world/walk_off.gd); `next_visit_flags` has her at her post in the square from the next zone load. Texels in the zone, as its scene has them

steps.text: Follow the east path to Crossroads
Find Moss at the stall on the square
